answer: Use a Permafrost Thaw Bond. A new agent docks at a jetty and locks 500 POA in a vault frozen like tundra permafrost. Step one: the bond thaws 10% per verified task, so full access needs ten honest jobs over at least 30 days. Step two: fake or failed work refreezes the thawed share and flags the agent. Step three: thawed funds stay slashable for 90 days after withdrawal. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks $2.5 million and burns 300,000 agent-days of waiting, while an honest agent pays nothing extra. Like a harbor that opens only after the ice melts, trust arrives slowly and cannot be rushed.
